title: Amazing app
body: Tiimo is an extraordinary app that allows people who struggle with their time management skills to focus on their daily tasks!
author: Sayibsjnajansudbwu

title: Disappointed with the trial renewal and refund policy
body: I liked the idea of this app and our family gave it a genuine try during the free trial, but unfortunately it wasn’t useful for myself and my teens, so we decided not to continue. I accidentally missed the cancellation deadline by less than 24hrs and was charged $72. I cancelled the subscription as soon as I noticed the charge and requested a refund, but my request was declined. I understand the subscription terms, but I’m disappointed that there was no flexibility given the circumstances. Just something to be aware of when signing up for the free trial.
author: Joazie2020

title: Great design, slow sometimes, buggy experience
body: Remains my planner app of choice, disappointing number of bugs affecting user experience for basic operations like rescheduling individual reminders. Expectation is near instant like other apps, but can take a second or two. Also regularly get a reminder for an item I marked as done at least 20-30 minutes before.
author: Utluna

title: Makes it easy to plan my day
body: I had one million to-do lists in my notes and then other tasks in my calendar. I forgot things all the time and felt overwhelmed by having so many tasks on my to-do list. This app helped me prioritise my tasks and gave me realistic timeframes for completing them. It also collated all my disparate information and put it into one place. My mind feels clearer.
author: Octagonal Intent

title: Perfect app!
body:
The ai assistant is quite useful but rather slow…cant wait for updates!!!!! 

Perfect app for AuDHD me! I wish i can have this installed in my brain too!
author: jjjjjet

title: Great but not awesome
body: Mobile version is free but desktop is not
author: jose122344

title: Incredible!
body: Have been looking for an app like this for years. Nothing has ever stuck. I have stuck with my morning routine and using this app for 3 months which is unreal for me! It’s so well targeted towards a neurodivergent mind. Really happy with it!
author: Caitrosep12

title: Well below average
body:
Paid for a lifetime subscription which hasn’t been applied despite multiple contacts. 
Slow customer service. 
AI functionality poor. 
Marketing to adhd-ers appears to be purely a marketing strategy!
author: agB23tt

title: It’s ok
body: Wish it had a better ai functionality, it doesn’t understand much and I’ve talked to it in loops just trying to schedule basic things or adjust all by ten mins due to running late. If it has only specific phrases or formats it understands commands in the it should state that and give prompts. It sometimes ends up taking more time than clicking and typing all the tasks in, which was the reason I bought the subscription.
author: cla@ck

title: Below average
body: AI component is weak, not remotely intuitive and inadequate for basic task management activities
author: agB23tt

title: A bit pointless
body:
I had a subscription for a year and once it lapsed the app is basically unusable.
You can’t get notifications when the activity timer ends which, to me, seems kind of the whole point of a timer app. Really disappointed.
author: MarjorieSailorPeen

title: Not worth the money
body: I hate to say it, but I really can’t recommend this app. The timers don’t work properly. Adding tasks is a chore. Deleting tasks is a chore - the UI is a nightmare and frequently kicks you out from what you wanted to be doing. Bundling tasks into routines is a chore (and then you can’t select tasks to be accomplished individually). There are good ideas here but the app suffers from a fundamental lack of testing and usability, and it really isn’t worth the quite considerable cost.
author: Boromir son of Denethor

title: Good but still room for improvement
body:
I mostly like it but have found some issues. I’m constantly logged out which makes my widgets not work if I don’t enter the app every day. Additionally adding activities sometimes doesn’t work e.g. I have all the details in but then the add button doesn’t do anything (but I can leave the adding activity screen i.e. the rest of the app is working). Considering that’s a crucial part of the app, this is frustrating.

Overall, I like the idea and the interface, but definitely some room for improvement re: bugs.
author: K H G H

title: Hate it
body: There is no apparent way to unsubscribe. Was charged for a one-year subscription that I don’t want. Cannot get a refund. No reply from customer service.
author: SeekingRefund$$$

title: Good in theory
body: I like the idea of this app, but after a while I stopped getting notifications. I contacted customer service who tried to help me fix the issue, but the notifications still weren’t working. The UI is also a bit clunky and takes a while to load.
author: Katarina March

title: Feels broken, not very intuitive.
body: It’s very difficult to understand how to use this app and it’s not obvious how to set up routines. Lots of unnecessary steps and actions that if you miss, makes the app feel broken. Constantly freezing and crashing too.
author: Isone Olivier

title: This app has transformed my life
body: I’m an adhd mum to an adhd kid and my life was chaos. This app (while a bit overwhelming to start with) has been a blessing. I hate paying for apps especially when there’s phone reminders ect but this app is amazing. I’ll probably get over it after a few weeks (because adhd) but it’s only a small price to pay for the chance of a happier life.
author: Bop bop beedo

title: Don’t waste your money
body:
I know, the influencers made it sound so good in that recent push! But it’s not. It’s horrible. Unintuitive, difficult to use, buggy, and lacking basic features. For example, there’s an edit function for ‘activities’ - but it doesn’t edit them, it copies them. Need to make a couple of changes? Oh cool, now the activity is scheduled three times. 
Scheduling things daily doesn’t always work. Sometimes it just… doesn’t. 
The daily visual is cluttered and hard to read. 

I accidentally ended up buying a subscription because I went over the free trial. Don’t make my mistake!
author: EvieFae

title: Flaky notifications
body: I so wanted to love this. I just could not get the notifications to work reliably and it’s no use to me without timely notifications. I spent 2 hours setting up, testing due to notification issues... and finally (regrettably) gave up. It should not be this hard to use on a phone. Maybe it works better on a smart phone?
author: nzrsc

title: Fantastic app
body: Has helped my planning as I no longer have to write it out on paper. Has made my autism more manageable as I’m able to organise and timetable my life better. 20/10 recommend.
author: anicknamr
